1	\section{Introduction}
2	\label{sec:introduction}
3	
4	Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation increasingly relies on LLM-as-a-judge protocols, where one or more LLM judges score model responses on structured benchmarks \citep{zheng2023mtbench}. Two well-documented sources of distortion affect these evaluations: \emph{judge bias}, where different judges assign systematically different scores to the same response, and \emph{benchmark contamination}, where models achieve inflated scores on items encountered during training. Both problems have received sustained research attention, producing separate toolkits for bias calibration and contamination detection. These toolkits treat the two distortions as independent phenomena, a separation that reflects their origins in different research communities rather than any principled argument for independence. Accurate ability ranking is essential for model selection, safety evaluation, and benchmark design; systematic distortion in estimated abilities undermines all three. Yet a practitioner who needs both corrections must apply them sequentially: first correct one source of distortion, then the other. This sequential approach produces unreliable ability estimates. In synthetic experiments with 50 models, 100 items, and 8 judges, sequential estimation yields ability root mean squared error (RMSE) of $0.221 \pm 0.038$, while joint estimation achieves $0.124 \pm 0.016$, a 43.8\% reduction (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-6}$). The gap does not arise from estimation noise or algorithmic limitations of individual methods; it reflects structural confounding between judge bias and contamination that no sequential pipeline can resolve.
5	
6	Existing judge bias correction methods remove systematic differences across judges without modeling contamination. CyclicJudge \citep{cyclicjudge2026} uses round-robin pairing to cancel average bias through balanced exposure of model pairs to all judges, but treats all residual score variation as genuine ability signal. UDA \citep{uda2026} learns a neural K-factor adjustment that reduces inter-judge standard deviation by 63.4\%, yet operates as a black-box transformation with no mechanism for contamination effects. On the contamination side, ConStat \citep{constat2024} compares target model performance against a reference model to estimate item-level contamination ($r^2 = 0.94$ with true contamination levels in controlled settings), DCR \citep{dcr2025} applies fuzzy inference to adjust scores on suspected leaked items, and LogProber \citep{logprober2024} probes token-level log-probabilities to detect memorization signatures. These two families of methods operate in separate silos. A bias-first pipeline absorbs contamination-induced score inflation into the ability estimates, because the bias model attributes all residual systematic variation to genuine ability differences. A contamination-first pipeline misattributes judge severity differences as contamination signals, because score elevation from a lenient judge is indistinguishable from score elevation due to memorization without a joint model. In either ordering, the first correction stage produces estimates already distorted by the unmodeled facet, and the second stage inherits this distortion with no mechanism for self-correction.
7	
8	We formalize this confounding as an omitted variable bias (OVB) problem \citep{angrist2009mostly}. Within the Many-Facet Rasch Model (MFRM) framework \citep{linacre1989mfrm}, the complete data-generating process includes both judge severity $d_j$ and a contamination interaction $c_n \cdot e_i$. Fitting a specification that includes one facet but omits the other produces asymptotically biased parameter estimates whenever the two facets are non-orthogonal. This non-orthogonality holds in practice: lenient judges (low severity $d_j$) amplify score inflation on exposed items, while strict judges compress it, creating systematic dependence between judge effects and contamination effects. The OVB framework predicts that the bias magnitude scales with the contamination susceptibility $c_n$ of each model, so the most contaminated models receive the largest upward distortion in estimated ability. For practical benchmark evaluations, this means that the more a model's training data overlaps with the benchmark, the more its ability is overestimated, precisely the failure mode that contamination correction is designed to prevent. Synthetic validation confirms the predicted pattern: the Pearson correlation between sequential estimation bias and true $c_n$ reaches $r = 0.86$ ($p < 0.001$), which shows that contaminated models are systematically overestimated under both sequential orderings (Section~\ref{sec:confounding}).
9	
10	We propose the Gated Many-Facet Rasch Model (G-MFRM), which combines the multi-facet structure of MFRM \citep{linacre1989mfrm, jiao2025mfrm_llm} with the gating mechanism of Doubly-Gated Item Response Theory (DG-IRT) \citep{shu2013dgirt} to jointly estimate model ability, judge severity, and contamination susceptibility in a single measurement framework. When $c_n = 0$ or $e_i = 0$, the gating term vanishes and the model reduces to standard MFRM, so uncontaminated model-item pairs incur no distortion. A complementary error propagation analysis bounds the impact of Stage~2 measurement noise: when exposure estimation error satisfies $\sigma \leq 0.2$, ability RMSE degradation remains below 6\%. Figure~\ref{fig:framework} provides an overview of the complete framework.
11	
12	Our contributions are as follows:

14	    \item We formalize the confounding between judge bias and benchmark contamination in LLM evaluation as an omitted variable bias problem, and show that sequential correction produces directional bias proportional to model contamination levels (Section~\ref{sec:confounding}, Figure~\ref{fig:ovb_bias}).
15	    \item We propose the G-MFRM framework with formal identifiability guarantees (Propositions~\ref{prop:no_new}--\ref{prop:exposure_variation} and Theorem~\ref{thm:sufficient}) and quantified error propagation bounds for the staged estimation procedure (Section~\ref{sec:method}, Figure~\ref{fig:error_prop}, Table~\ref{tab:error_prop}).
16	    \item Synthetic validation confirms that joint estimation reduces ability RMSE by 43.8\% relative to sequential estimation ($p < 10^{-6}$), with Kendall rank correlation $\tau = 0.922$ versus $\tau = 0.859$ (Section~\ref{sec:experiments}).
17	    \item Empirical validation on real-data evaluation with 9 LLM judges and 9 target models on Arena-Hard, comparing G-MFRM fair scores against human preference rankings from Chatbot Arena (Section~\ref{sec:experiments}). %% [Phase 2: numbers TBD]
18	\end{enumerate}

The OVB formalization adapts the classical Angrist & Pischke result to MFRM, claiming that plim(θ̃_n - θ_n) = γ_n · c_n, but there's a fundamental issue here: the OVB formula assumes linearity, while MFRM is a log-linear model, so the direct application needs more careful justification.

The correlation mechanism between d_j and c_n·e_i also feels underdeveloped—the authors suggest lenient judges amplify inflation, but they don't clearly explain why these two different facets would actually be correlated in practice.

For Proposition 1, the proof strategy is to assume c_n' = c_n + δ and show that δ·e_i must equal zero for all i, which would force δ = 0, but this argument hinges on whether the e_i vectors actually span the space in the way the proof assumes.

Proposition 2 is straightforward: when exposure is uniform across items, the judge effect c_n and the item parameters θ_n become completely confounded, which the authors demonstrate cleanly.

Theorem 1 appears to be cut off, but it's setting up sufficient conditions for local identifiability.

For Theorem 1, the proof relies on the Fisher information matrix determinant formula, which takes a Cauchy-Schwarz form. The conditions listed include a fully crossed design, multiple judges, varying exposure values, and standard normalization. However, there's some redundancy here—conditions (iii) and (iv) are essentially saying the same thing, since having at least two distinct exposure values automatically implies positive variance. This overlap suggests the conditions could be stated more precisely.

The weights in the Fisher information matrix depend on the true parameter values, making identifiability local rather than global, which is mentioned but without much discussion of practical implications. There's also no treatment of what happens when the required conditions are approximately but not exactly satisfied, like when exposure varies only slightly.

Moving to the error propagation analysis, the attenuation factor follows the standard errors-in-variables formula, with a critical threshold at 50% attenuation. But the analysis assumes the exposure estimation error is normally distributed and independent of all model parameters, which is unrealistic given that the error comes from Stage 2 estimation and likely correlates with other components.

The synthetic data results showing specific improvements in θ-RMSE are tied to a particular data generation process, so it's unclear how well these findings generalize to real scenarios. The Murphy-Topel variance correction gets mentioned but never actually derived or tested.

For the G-MFRM design itself, the multiplicative contamination structure assumes the effect of contamination is separable from item difficulty and judge characteristics, which is a strong simplification. The non-negativity constraint on contamination is enforced through a horseshoe prior with absolute value, but the implications of this choice aren't fully explored.

The non-negativity assumption itself is worth questioning—contamination could theoretically suppress scores on some items if memorized answers conflict with current scoring standards, yet the model only allows contamination to increase scores. The horseshoe hyperparameters (HalfCauchy(1.0) for τ_c and λ_n, InverseGamma(2.0, 8.0) for the slab) are presented as "regularized" without justification, and I haven't checked how sensitive the results are to these choices.

For the three-stage estimation, the first stage using MFRM as a warm-start is straightforward. The second stage combines reference model anchoring at 75% weight with cross-model agreement at 25%, but the weighting scheme itself needs justification. # ARR Reviewer Responsibilities & Assessment Guidance

## Key Reviewer Responsibilities

Reviewers must complete four primary tasks:

1. **Allocate adequate time** for both reviewing and discussion phases
2. **Verify assignment appropriateness** by checking expertise alignment and conflicts of interest
3. **Write substantive reviews** addressing soundness, novelty, and contribution quality
4. **Engage in author discussion** and update assessments based on responses

## Assessment Framework

### Soundness Evaluation
Reviewers assess technical correctness and methodological rigor. Per guidelines: "low soundness scores must be justified by the text of the review." Scores should reflect actual flaws identified, not unconscious biases.

### Novelty & Contribution
The document emphasizes that contributions take multiple forms beyond empirical results—including resources, analyses, reproductions, and surveys. Reviewers shouldn't demand SOTA results when papers make valid scientific contributions through other dimensions (efficiency, interpretability, fairness).

### Completeness Standards

**Papers requiring desk rejection must demonstrate:**
- Style/length violations (exceeding 4 or 8 pages)
- Missing limitations sections
- Inadequate responsible NLP checklist responses
- Hallucinated citations
- Anonymity breaches

**Otherwise incomplete work** should be evaluated contextually. The guidelines caution against penalizing acknowledged limitations as weaknesses.

## Critical Guidance

Reviewers should read papers twice—first for research question and methodology appropriateness, then for technical depth. They must "be specific" rather than vague, cite particular examples, and avoid common heuristic errors like dismissing work for seeming "obvious" or lacking novelty.

# Reviewer 1 — 方法严谨性审查报告

## Summary

本文提出 Gated Many-Facet Rasch Model (G-MFRM)，通过在 MFRM 中引入乘法门控项 $c_n \cdot e_i$ 联合建模 judge bias 和 benchmark contamination。理论框架（OVB formalization、identifiability analysis、error propagation bounds）整体逻辑清晰，是将 psychometric measurement 引入 LLM 评估的有意义尝试。然而，**Section 4 (Experiments)、Section 6 (Conclusion)、Limitations 三个章节完全为空**，论文处于未完成状态，无法作为完整投稿评审。在方法论层面，OVB 从线性模型到序数 logistic 模型的迁移缺乏严格论证，Theorem 1 仅提供 proof sketch，error propagation 的 i.i.d. Gaussian 噪声假设过强。

## Strengths

- **S1**: 将 judge bias 与 contamination 的交互建模为 OVB 问题是一个有洞察力的 framing。Section 2 清晰展示了 sequential estimation 的结构性失败模式（bias-first 和 contamination-first 均产生方向性偏差），Figure 1 的 synthetic validation（r=0.86, p<0.001）直观有力。

- **S2**: Identifiability analysis（§3.3）结构完整——Proposition 1 证明外部固定 $e_i$ 不引入新的不确定性，Proposition 2 证明 exposure variation 的必要性，Theorem 1 给出局部可识别的充分条件。Fisher information determinant 的 Cauchy-Schwarz 论证思路正确。

- **S3**: Error propagation analysis（§3.4）将 staged estimation 的 generated regressors 问题显式量化，定义了 $\sigma_{\mathrm{crit}} = \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}(e_i)}$ 作为可操作的质量阈值，使 Stage 2 exposure estimation 的精度要求变得可验证（falsifiable）。

- **S4**: 与 DG-IRT 的对比定位清晰（continuous exposure vs. binary, multi-facet vs. single-rater, external estimation vs. known），区分了方法贡献的边界。

- **S5**: Horseshoe prior 的选择合理——contamination 在模型群体中应当是稀疏的，horseshoe 的 adaptive shrinkage 比 Lasso 或 fixed spike-and-slab 更适合这种稀疏结构。

## Weaknesses

### [Critical] W1: 论文严重不完整——Experiments/Conclusion/Limitations 为空

Section 4 仅含占位注释 `%% [Phase 2: to be written after exp-001 through exp-005 complete]`，Section 6 和 Limitations 同样为空。这意味着：
- 论文声称的 43.8% RMSE reduction 和 τ=0.922（Introduction 第4段、Contribution 3）**没有独立的实验章节展示**，仅以内联数字散布在 §1-§3 中，无法系统验证。
- Contribution 4 明确标注 "numbers TBD"（introduction.tex line 17）。
- 无 Limitations section 违反 ARR submission requirements（ARR guidelines 将缺少 limitations 列为 desk rejection 条件）。
- 无 Conclusion 导致论文缺乏对贡献和局限性的总结性讨论。

**影响**：按照 ARR 政策，缺少 Limitations section 可构成 desk rejection。即使不 desk reject，一篇没有独立实验章节的方法论文无法评估其 empirical claims 的可信度。

### [Critical] W2: OVB 从线性模型到非线性模型的迁移缺乏严格论证

Observation 1（§2, Eq. 3）直接将 Angrist & Pischke (2009) 的 OVB 公式 $\mathrm{plim}(\tilde{\theta}_n - \theta_n) = \gamma_n \cdot c_n$ 应用于 MFRM。但 MFRM 是一个 cumulative logit 模型（Eq. 1），OVB 公式在其经典形式下仅对线性模型严格成立。作者在 background.tex line 34 提到 "In the linear analogue"，部分承认了这一点，但 Observation 1 的 formal statement 中未做此限定——它被呈现为一个关于 MFRM 的精确结论。

对于非线性模型，omitted variable 的影响更为复杂：(a) bias 的方向和大小取决于参数的真值（不仅仅是 $\gamma_n \cdot c_n$），(b) 还存在 collider bias 和 nonlinear interaction 等效应。至少需要引用 nonlinear OVB 的相关文献（如 Wooldridge 2010 §15.8 关于 nonlinear models 中 omitted variables 的讨论），或通过 simulation 验证该近似在 MFRM 参数范围内的精度。

### [Critical] W3: Theorem 1 仅为 proof sketch，未提供完整证明

Theorem 1 是本文最核心的理论贡献之一（identifiability guarantee），但仅提供 "Proof sketch"：
- Fisher information matrix 的 weights $w_{nij}$ 未给出显式定义（它们依赖于真实参数值，意味着 identifiability 是 local 的）。
- Eq. 6 仅给出 $(\theta_n, c_n)$ 子块的行列式，但 $b_i$ 和 $d_j$ 对应子块的 non-singularity 仅声称 "inherit from standard MFRM" 而无推导。
- **关键遗漏**：未讨论 cross-blocks 之间的耦合——即使对角子块各自非奇异，完整 Fisher 矩阵的非奇异性还需要子块间交互项不破坏整体结构。一个 block diagonal dominance 论证或对完整矩阵结构的分析是必要的。

对于一篇声称提供 "formal identifiability guarantees" 的论文，proof sketch 不足以支撑该 claim。建议将完整证明放入 Appendix。

### [Major] W4: Error propagation 的 i.i.d. Gaussian 假设过强

§3.4 假设 $\hat{e}_i = e_i + \epsilon_i$，其中 $\epsilon_i \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$ 独立于所有模型参数。这在实际中不太可能成立：
- **异方差性**：接近边界（$e_i \approx 0$ 或 $e_i \approx 1$）的 exposure 估计误差分布与中间值处可能截然不同（类似于 proportion estimation 的 variance structure）。
- **非独立性**：Stage 2 使用 reference model anchoring 和 cross-model agreement，两者都依赖于 response data 的某些统计量，因此 $\epsilon_i$ 与 Stage 3 中的参数不完全独立。
- **非正态性**：exposure 被 clip 到 $[0,1]$，边界效应会导致估计误差呈非对称分布。

Eq. 7 的 attenuation factor $\lambda(\sigma)$ 是经典 errors-in-variables 结果，在上述假设违背时可能低估或高估实际衰减。§3.4 的具体数字（θ-RMSE 增 5.9%、$c_n$-RMSE 增 7.9%）来自特定 DGP 的 synthetic data，对 realistic scenarios 的外推性未知。

### [Major] W5: Stage 2 exposure estimation 的设计决策缺乏论证

Stage 2 是整个方法论的关键环节（因为 identifiability 依赖于外部固定的 $e_i$），但多个设计选择未给出理由：
- **75%/25% 权重**（reference model anchoring vs. cross-model agreement）：为什么是这个比例？是否做过 sensitivity analysis？
- **Reference model 选择**（gpt-4-0314）：如果 reference model 本身有 contamination，会引入系统性偏差。这一 circular dependency 未被讨论。
- **Clipping to [0,1]**：clipping 引入了 bias（真实 exposure 接近边界时估计被截断），这与 §3.4 的 unbiased noise 假设矛盾。

### [Major] W6: 与 DG-IRT 的差异程度是否构成足够的方法贡献

§3.1 最后一段声称 G-MFRM 与 DG-IRT (Shu et al., 2013) 有三个差异：(1) continuous vs. binary exposure, (2) multi-facet vs. single-rater, (3) external vs. known exposure。逐条审视：
- (1) 从 binary 到 continuous 是参数空间的自然扩展，不涉及新的建模原理。
- (2) 加入 judge severity $d_j$ 是 MFRM 的标准做法，不是本文的创新。
- (3) External estimation + staged procedure 是本文的核心贡献，但也引入了 generated regressors 问题。

实质性的方法创新集中在 (3) 以及配套的 identifiability/error propagation 分析。论文需要更清楚地区分 "组合已有组件" 和 "新的方法原理"。在 experiments section 缺失的情况下，无法判断该组合是否在实践中产生了超越各组件之和的效果。

### [Major] W7: MCMC 收敛标准偏宽松

§3.2 使用 $\hat{R} < 1.05$ 和 ESS > 200 作为收敛判据。
- $\hat{R} < 1.05$ 是旧标准；Vehtari et al. (2021, "Rank-normalization, folding, and localization") 推荐 $\hat{R} < 1.01$，并建议使用 rank-normalized split-$\hat{R}$。对于 horseshoe prior 这类 heavy-tailed 参数（$\tau_c$, $\lambda_n$），标准 $\hat{R}$ 可能遗漏尾部不收敛。
- ESS > 200 对于 posterior mean 可能足够，但对 posterior quantiles（credible intervals）不够——Murphy-Topel correction 的可靠性依赖于 posterior 的准确估计。
- 仅在 footnote 中报告了 synthetic data 的收敛指标（max $\hat{R}$ = 1.02, min ESS = 276），未讨论 real-data scenario（如模型更多、exposure 分布不同时）的收敛行为。

### [Minor] W8: Theorem 1 条件 (iii) 和 (iv) 冗余

条件 (iii) "$|\{e_i\}| \geq 2$"（至少两个不同的 exposure 值）逻辑上蕴含条件 (iv) "$\mathrm{Var}(e_i) > 0$"。在形式化定理中保留冗余条件会影响数学表述的精确性。

### [Minor] W9: $c_n \geq 0$ 约束的合理性

论文通过 $c_n = |\tau_c \cdot \tilde{\lambda}_n \cdot c^{\mathrm{raw}}_n|$ 强制 $c_n \geq 0$，隐含假设 contamination 只能提升分数。但存在反例：(a) 模型记忆了旧版 benchmark 答案，与当前评分标准不一致；(b) 对抗性 contamination。至少需要讨论这一假设的适用范围。

### [Minor] W10: 未解析的交叉引用

多处出现 "Figure ??" 和 "Table ??"（如 §3.4 引用的 Figure 2 和 Table 2），表明论文未经完整编译检查。

## Questions

**Q1**: Observation 1 的 OVB 公式在 MFRM（ordinal logistic model）中的精确适用条件是什么？作者是否验证过该近似在典型 MFRM 参数范围内的误差？

**Q2**: Theorem 1 的完整证明是否可用？特别是，完整 Fisher information matrix 的非奇异性如何从各子块的非奇异性推出？

**Q3**: Stage 2 的 75/25 权重是如何确定的？是否做过不同权重比例的 sensitivity analysis？如果 reference model 本身被 contaminate，Stage 2 的 exposure 估计会如何偏移？

**Q4**: Horseshoe prior 的超参数（$\tau_c \sim \text{HalfCauchy}(1.0)$, $c^2_{\mathrm{slab}} \sim \text{InverseGamma}(2.0, 8.0)$）是否做过 sensitivity analysis？在 contamination 比例不同（如 0% vs. 50% 模型被 contaminate）的场景下，prior 的行为是否稳定？

**Q5**: 论文多次引用 exp-012 的 synthetic results，但无独立实验章节。这些结果的完整实验设定（DGP 参数、随机种子数、baseline 方法细节）在哪里可以找到？

**Q6**: Murphy-Topel variance correction 的具体推导是什么？对 Stage 3 posterior credible intervals 的覆盖率有多大影响？

## Missing References

- **Vehtari, Gelman, Simpson, Carpenter & Bürkner (2021)** "Rank-normalization, folding, and localization: An improved R̂ for assessing convergence of MCMC"——关于 MCMC 收敛诊断的当前最佳实践，应替代论文中使用的旧 $\hat{R} < 1.05$ 标准。
- **Wooldridge (2010)** *Econometric Analysis of Cross Section and Panel Data*, §15.8——关于非线性模型中 omitted variable bias 的讨论，可支撑 Observation 1 的论证。
- **Pagan & Hall (1983)** 或 **Murphy & Topel (1985, 2002)** 的完整引用——Murphy-Topel correction 在 method section 中被提及但引用信息不完整。

## Official Dimensions (ACL ARR Review Form)

| 维度 | 分数 | 理由摘要 |

# Reviewer 1 对 Reviewer 2 审稿意见的逐条回应

## Overall Assessment 回应

[AGREE] R2 给出 1.5 (Resubmit after next cycle)，与我的评分一致。理由也基本相同：论文严重不完整，且即使补全实验也需要额外理论工作。

## Strengths 回应

**[AGREE] R2-S1**: 问题定位精准。OVB framing 确实是本文最有价值的贡献。我在 R1-S1 中同样肯定了这一点，并特别指出 Figure 1 的 synthetic validation（r=0.86）直观展示了 sequential estimation 的结构性失败。

**[REBUT] R2-S2**: "理论框架严谨"的措辞过于笼统。Proposition 1-2 的证明确实完备，但 Theorem 1 仅为 proof sketch（§3.3，标注为 "Proof sketch"），完整 Fisher information matrix 的非奇异性论证缺失——仅声称 $b_i$, $d_j$ 子块 "inherit non-singularity from the standard MFRM"（method.tex line 83），未处理 cross-block 耦合。此外，Observation 1 的 OVB 公式（Eq. 3）从线性模型直接迁移到 cumulative logit 模型未经严格论证（background.tex line 34 自己承认 "In the linear analogue"）。识别性论证链的方向正确，但"严谨"需要打折扣。

**[AGREE] R2-S3**: $\sigma_{\mathrm{crit}}$ 确实有实用价值。但我在 R1-W4 中指出，该分析的 i.i.d. Gaussian 噪声假设（$\epsilon_i \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$，method.tex line 93）在 Stage 2 的实际 exposure estimation 中不太可能成立（异方差性、边界效应、与 response data 的非独立性）。实用价值以假设合理性为前提。

**[AGREE] R2-S4**: 三阶段设计逻辑合理，符合 identifiability 分析的要求。

**[AGREE] R2-S5**: Related Work 覆盖面较广，四个平行线（judge bias、contamination detection、preference leakage、IRT/MFRM for LLM）均有涉及。但 R2 后面指出的遗漏（W3、W4）是合理的。

---

## Must-Fix Weaknesses 回应

**[AGREE] R2-N1**: 完全同意。我在 R1-W1 中做了相同判断。补充一点：散布在 §1-§3 中的数字（43.8% RMSE reduction、τ=0.922、r=0.86）缺乏独立实验章节的系统性展示，读者无法判断这些数字的完整实验条件（DGP 参数仅在脚注中部分提及，如 method.tex line 40 的 footnote: N=50, I=100, J=8）。

**[AGREE] R2-N2**: 完全同意。ARR guidelines 明确将缺少 Limitations 列为 desk rejection 条件。我在 R1-W1 中也指出了这一点。

**[AGREE] R2-N3**: 完全同意。§3.4 引用的 Figure 2 和 Table 2（method.tex line 103: "Figure~\ref{fig:error_prop} and Table~\ref{tab:error_prop}"）在 PDF 中显示为 "Figure ??" 和 "Table ??"，表明这些 figures/tables 尚未创建或 label 未定义。

**[AGREE] R2-N4**: 完全同意。introduction.tex line 17 明确包含注释 `%% [Phase 2: numbers TBD]`，Contribution 4 关于 Arena-Hard real-data validation 的结果完全缺失。

---

## Should-Fix Weaknesses 回应

**[AGREE] R2-W1**: 与我的 R1-W6 判断一致。G-MFRM 相对 DG-IRT 的三个差异中，(1) continuous vs. binary exposure 是参数空间自然扩展，(2) 加入 $d_j$ 是 MFRM 标准做法，实质创新集中在 (3) external estimation + staged procedure 及配套 identifiability 分析。消融实验（如：仅加 $d_j$ 不加 $c_n$、仅加 $c_n$ 不加 $d_j$、joint vs. staged）是量化各组件贡献的必要手段，但 Experiments section 缺失使这无法评估。

**[REBUT] R2-W2**: 部分不同意。R2 认为 OVB formalization "是已知结果的直接应用"因此贡献层次需校准。但我认为贡献不在于 OVB 公式本身，而在于**将 judge bias 和 contamination 的交互识别为 OVB 问题**——这个 problem identification 是新的。Section 2 清晰展示了为什么 sequential correction（无论 bias-first 还是 contamination-first）在结构上无法解决这个问题（background.tex line 36），synthetic validation 也验证了这一预测（r=0.86）。将 Observation 1 列为 Contribution 1 在层次上是合适的——它为整篇论文提供了动机和理论基础。但我同意 R2 的隐含观点：作为 Contribution 1，它需要更严格的论证（即我在 R1-W2 中指出的非线性模型迁移问题）。

**[AGREE] R2-W3**: 遗漏 contamination avoidance 方法（LiveBench、SEAL、TRUCE）是一个有效批评。这类方法代表了一种完全不同的应对范式（避免 contamination 而非建模它），论文应在 Related Work 中讨论并解释为什么 post-hoc modeling 仍然必要（例如：即使用新 benchmark，旧数据仍在训练集中；动态更新成本高）。

**[REBUT] R2-W4**: 部分不同意。R2 列出的参考中：
- **Polo et al. (2024) tinyBenchmarks**：这是关于 benchmark 效率（用少量 items 估计能力）的工作，与 judge bias/contamination 建模不直接相关，可列可不列。

**[AGREE] R2-W5**: Abstract 中 "43.8% RMSE reduction"、"τ=0.922"、"Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-6}$" 这些具体数字在没有独立实验章节支撑的情况下出现在 abstract 中确实不妥。

**[AGREE] R2-W6**: Figure 1 是全文唯一的实验性图表，仅展示 OVB bias 的存在（sequential estimation bias vs. true $c_n$），不展示 G-MFRM 的性能。这对于一篇提出新方法的论文来说不够——至少需要一个展示 G-MFRM vs. baselines 性能对比的图表。

---

## Questions 回应

**[AGREE] R2-Q1**: 与我的 R1-W5 判断一致。Stage 2 的 exposure estimation 是全文方法论的 Achilles' heel：reference model 选择标准、75/25 权重理由、cross-model agreement 的具体计算方式（z-score standardization 的细节）、以及 exposure 估计的准确率均未报告。对于 identifiability 完全依赖于外部固定 $e_i$ 的方法，这些细节至关重要。

**[AGREE] R2-Q2**: 好问题。Theorem 1 条件 (i) 要求 fully crossed design（所有 $N \times I \times J$ cells observed），但实际 LLM evaluation 中常用 sparse design（每个 judge 只评一部分 items）。条件 (iii) 要求至少两个不同的 exposure 值——在 exposure 未知（需要 Stage 2 估计）的情况下，这变成了一个 chicken-and-egg 问题：identifiability 依赖 $e_i$ 的 variation，但 $e_i$ 的估计质量未经独立验证。论文应讨论这些条件在实际中的可满足性。

**[AGREE] R2-Q3**: 计算成本是实用性的关键考量。论文未报告任何计算时间。MCMC（NUTS）在高维参数空间（$N + I + J + N + K$ 参数）的 scaling behavior 需要讨论——尤其是 horseshoe prior 引入的 funnel geometry 可能导致 NUTS 步长适应困难。

**[AGREE] R2-Q4**: 这是一个有深度的问题。§3.5 将 G-MFRM 的 $\theta_n$ posterior mean 定义为 "fair score"，但如果 ground truth 本身来自有 bias 的 human annotators（如 Chatbot Arena 的 ELO ratings），那么 G-MFRM 与 human ranking 的对齐度高不一定意味着校正正确——也可能意味着 G-MFRM 继承了 human bias。论文需要讨论 validation ground truth 的局限性。

**[REBUT] R2-Q5**: 部分不同意这个担忧的严重程度。Horseshoe prior 的设计目标确实是稀疏场景（少数 $c_n$ 大，多数接近 0）。但 regularized horseshoe（Piironen & Vehtari, 2017）的 slab component $c^2_{\mathrm{slab}} \sim \text{InverseGamma}(2.0, 8.0)$ 正是为了防止对非零信号的过度收缩——它为大的 $c_n$ 提供了一个有限的 slab，避免经典 horseshoe 的 unbounded tail 问题。在 contamination 非稀疏场景下（如 >50% 模型被 contaminate），全局收缩参数 $\tau_c$ 的 posterior 会被 data 推高，减弱收缩效果。这是 horseshoe 的自适应机制，不一定导致系统性低估。但作者确实应做 sensitivity analysis 验证这一点（与我的 R1 Q4 一致）。

---

## Missing References 回应

**[AGREE]** LiveBench (White et al., 2024) — contamination avoidance 范式的代表，应在 Related Work 中讨论。

**[AGREE]** TRUCE (Rajore et al., 2024) — private benchmarking 方向，与 LiveBench 同属 avoidance 范式，至少应提及。

**[NEUTRAL]** Choi et al. (2026) arXiv:2602.00521 — 无法验证该引用的真实性和内容。如果确实是 IRT for LLM judge reliability 的近期工作，则高度相关。建议 Director 核实。

**[REBUT]** Polo et al. (2024) tinyBenchmarks — 这是关于 benchmark efficiency 的工作（用 IRT 选择少量 representative items），与 judge bias/contamination 建模的 framing 不同。可选引用，但遗漏不构成 weakness。

**[AGREE]** SEAL (Scale AI, 2024) — 如果是 private evaluation 方向的代表工作，应与 LiveBench/TRUCE 一起在 contamination avoidance 段落中提及。

---

## 总结

与 R2 在主要判断上高度一致：论文不完整是最核心问题（N1-N4），Overall 1.5 合理。在具体 weakness 上有两处分歧：(1) W2——OVB 作为 Contribution 1 的定位在 problem identification 层面是合适的，问题在于论证严格性而非贡献层次；(2) W4——遗漏个别论文是正常的，不应升至 major。我额外指出了 R2 未覆盖的方法论问题：OVB 非线性迁移（R1-W2）、Theorem 1 proof sketch 不完整（R1-W3）、error propagation 的 i.i.d. 假设（R1-W4）、MCMC 收敛标准偏宽松（R1-W7）。
